_note: Alpha Strike special abilities (Commander's Edition) - curated short explanations for the codes that come up at the table, extend as needed (CONCEPT 3.3). # stands for a number, #/#/# for values per range band S/M/L. In doubt the rulebook wins. Entry: {key, name, text}.
asOf: 2026-08 · Alpha Strike: Commander's Edition · every code in the unit database

abilities.name: Anti-Penetrative Ablation Armor
abilities.text: Ablative armor: ignores MTAS/BTAS tasers and armor-piercing ammunition.

abilities.name: Autocannon
abilities.text: Autocannon partial damage per range band; may fire special ammunition, otherwise treated as normal damage.

abilities.name: Angel ECM
abilities.text: Angel jamming field: like ECM, but counts as two ECM suites – overcomes simple countermeasures.

abilities.name: Advanced Fire Control
abilities.text: Advanced fire control: no attack penalties for IndustrialMechs/support vehicles due to basic fire control.

abilities.name: Anti-’Mech
abilities.text: Infantry may attack ’Mechs in close combat (swarm/leg attacks).

abilities.name: Anti-Missile System
abilities.text: −1 damage (min. 0) against attacks with an IF, LRM or SRM component from the front arc.

abilities.name: Armored Components
abilities.text: Armored components: the first critical hit against this unit is ignored.

abilities.name: Armored Motive System
abilities.text: Vehicles: motive crits are mitigated (−1 to the motive damage roll).

abilities.name: Artillery
abilities.text: Artillery strikes (area attacks, see rulebook); code = type, number = tubes: AIS/AC = Arrow IV (IS/Clan), S = Sniper, T = Thumper, LT = Long Tom, trailing C = cannon version (ARTSC, ARTTC, ARTLTC).

abilities.name: Barrier Armor Rating
abilities.text: Weak armor (industrial/primitive): armor damage counts as structure damage – roll for a crit on every hit.

abilities.name: Basic Fire Control
abilities.text: Basic fire control: +1 to attacks by this IndustrialMech/vehicle (already included if the card is current).

abilities.name: Bloodhound Active Probe
abilities.text: Bloodhound probe: 26″ range, unaffected by ECM.

abilities.name: BattleMech HarJel
abilities.text: Sealing system: hull breaches under water/in vacuum are ignored. HarJel II/III additionally regenerate 2 or 3 armor per turn.

abilities.name: Ballistic-Reinforced Armor
abilities.text: Ballistic-reinforced armor: half damage from AC, IATM, IF, LRM and SRM special attacks.

abilities.name: Booby Trap
abilities.text: Booby trap: can self-detonate – damage equal to half its point value to everything within 1″.

abilities.key: C3M / C3S / C3BSM / C3BSS / C3EM / C3I
abilities.name: C3 network
abilities.text: Within the same C3 network: targets at short range of a network member with line of sight count as one range bracket closer for all members. Master (M) links, slaves (S) benefit; C3I is the decentralised Clan/ComStar counterpart.

abilities.name: Cellular Ammunition Storage
abilities.text: Ammo hit: 1 extra damage instead of destruction – the ’Mech survives the explosion.

abilities.name: CASE II
abilities.text: Ammo hits are ignored completely (no extra damage).

abilities.name: Critical Resistant
abilities.text: Hard to cripple: all crit rolls against this unit −2.

abilities.name: Cargo Transport
abilities.text: Cargo transport: can carry # tons (CT) or kilotons (CK) of cargo, or units with the CAR ability.

abilities.name: Drone Carrier Control
abilities.text: Drone control station: can control up to # drones (DRO) at once.

abilities.name: RISC Viral Jammer (Decoy)
abilities.text: Decoy jammer: disrupts enemy electronics (see rulebook).

abilities.name: Direct Neural Control
abilities.text: Direct neural interface: Skill −1; a fire control crit additionally stuns the crew.

abilities.name: Drone
abilities.text: Unmanned drone: Skill +1, needs a control station (DCC); shuts down inside an ECM field.

abilities.name: Electronic Countermeasures
abilities.text: 6″ jamming field: enemy C3 networks, drones and PRB/BH advantages are suppressed inside it.

abilities.name: RISC Emergency Coolant System
abilities.text: Emergency coolant: can shed extra heat, but risks self-damage (see rulebook).

abilities.name: Elementary Engine
abilities.text: Non-fusion engine (combustion/battery): engine hits can explode.

abilities.name: Energy
abilities.text: All-energy weaponry: no ammunition, ammo crits have no effect.

abilities.name: Engineering
abilities.text: Engineering equipment: can clear woods and work terrain (like SAW).

abilities.name: Ejection Seat
abilities.text: Ejection seat: on an ammo crit the pilot ejects automatically and survives.

abilities.name: Fuel Cell Engine
abilities.text: Fuel cell engine: like EE – no fusion reactor, engine hits can explode.

abilities.name: Flak
abilities.text: Anti-aircraft: against airborne targets the FLK damage applies and the attack gets −2.

abilities.name: Fire Resistant
abilities.text: Fire-resistant armor: immune to HT extra heat and fire/inferno.

abilities.name: Hyperpulse Generator
abilities.text: Mobile HPG transmitter: strategic communication, special rules – no direct combat effect in battle.

abilities.name: Heat
abilities.text: On hits, inflicts extra heat on the target equal to the HT value for the range (max. 2 per turn).

abilities.name: Industrial TSM
abilities.text: Industrial myomer: +1 physical damage, but no sprinting.

abilities.name: Improved ATM
abilities.text: Clan iATM: missile partial damage per range band, may use special ammunition (see rulebook).

abilities.name: Indirect Fire
abilities.text: Indirect fire without line of sight using the IF damage value (long range); needs a spotter, attack +1.

abilities.name: Improved NARC Beacon
abilities.text: Improved NARC launcher: like SNARC, can additionally fire jamming/Nemesis pods.

abilities.name: Impact-Resistant Armor
abilities.text: Impact-resistant armor: melee/physical damage −1 (min. 1), crit rolls against this unit +1 (see rulebook).

abilities.name: Infantry Transport
abilities.text: Can carry # points of infantry.

abilities.name: Jumping (strong)
abilities.text: Above-average jump jets: +# to own TMM when jumping (instead of a flat +1).

abilities.name: Jumping (weak)
abilities.text: Weak jump jets: −# to the jump TMM bonus.

abilities.name: Large / Very Large / Super Large
abilities.text: Oversized unit: easier to hit (−1 per step to enemy attacks) and special rules for transport/terrain.

abilities.name: Light Active Probe
abilities.text: Light sensor probe: detects hidden units within 6″ (instead of 3″ visibility).

abilities.name: Long Range Missiles
abilities.text: LRM partial damage per band – relevant for AMS, special ammunition and indirect fire.

abilities.name: Light TAG
abilities.text: Light laser designator: like TAG, but only 6″ range.

abilities.name: Mimetic Armor System
abilities.text: Mimetic camouflage: if the unit did not move, +3 to enemy to-hit numbers (LMAS: +2).

abilities.name: Mine Dispenser
abilities.text: Mine layer: can lay minefields as a special attack.

abilities.name: Melee
abilities.text: Melee weapon (sword, hatchet …): physical attack with 2″ reach and Size +1 damage.

abilities.name: Mobile Headquarters
abilities.text: Mobile headquarters: provides # points of command range for command special rules.

abilities.name: ’Mech Taser
abilities.text: ’Mech taser: special attack that can disable/shut down units it hits.

abilities.name: Nova CEWS
abilities.text: Nova combined system: like C3i (max. 3 units) plus ECM plus probe – and itself immune to ECM.

abilities.name: OmniMech
abilities.text: Omni unit: can carry battle armor as riders and is freely reconfigurable in campaign play.

abilities.name: Overheat Long
abilities.text: Overheat also applies at long range (otherwise only short/medium).

abilities.name: Active Probe
abilities.text: Active probe: detects hidden units within 12″.

abilities.name: RISC Advanced Point Defense
abilities.text: Missile defense: reduces damage from MSL/LRM/SRM attacks and also protects nearby units.

abilities.name: Reactive Armor
abilities.text: Reactive armor: reduced damage from ART, BOMB, MSL, LRM, SRM, IF and FLK attacks.

abilities.name: Recon
abilities.text: Scout: advantages under spotting and initiative special rules.

abilities.name: Rear Weapons
abilities.text: Rear weapons: attack into the rear arc with the REAR values, to-hit +1.

abilities.name: Re-Engineered Lasers
abilities.text: Re-engineered lasers: ignore RFA reflective armor and reduce the target’s CR advantage to −1.

abilities.name: Reflective Armor
abilities.text: Laser-reflective armor: reduces damage from energy attacks; REL bypasses it (see rulebook).

abilities.name: Radical Heat Sink
abilities.text: Radical heat sink: can attempt to shed extra heat – with a risk of failure (see rulebook).

abilities.name: Remote Sensor Dispenser
abilities.text: Can deploy # remote sensors (spotting without own line of sight).

abilities.name: Saw
abilities.text: Industrial saw: can clear woods.

abilities.name: Environmental Sealing
abilities.text: Environmentally sealed: underwater/vacuum without special damage.

abilities.name: BattleMech Shield
abilities.text: Shield: −1 damage taken, but +1 to own weapon attacks; does not work against area damage, heat or IF.

abilities.name: NARC Missile Beacon
abilities.text: NARC launcher (medium range): a marked target takes +1 damage from units with IF, LRM or SRM until the end of the game. CNARC = Compact (short range).

abilities.name: Space Operations Adaptation
abilities.text: Space-capable: can operate in vacuum/space.

abilities.name: Searchlight
abilities.text: Searchlight: negates night-fighting modifiers against illuminated targets (makes itself visible).

abilities.name: Short Range Missiles
abilities.text: SRM partial damage per band – relevant for AMS and special ammunition.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.text: Stealth system: attacks against this unit +1 at medium, +2 at long range.

abilities.name: Submersible Movement
abilities.text: Submersible drive: can move under water; the value modifies TMM in water (W = weak, S = strong).

abilities.name: Target Acquisition Gear
abilities.text: Laser designator: marks targets for artillery and homing ammunition (no damage of its own).

abilities.name: Torpedo
abilities.text: Torpedo launcher: damage per range band – only against targets in or under water.

abilities.name: Tight-Stream EMP
abilities.text: EMP cannon: special attack that can disrupt or completely shut down the target (-O = one-shot, see rulebook).

abilities.name: Triple-Strength Myomer
abilities.text: At heat level 1+: +2″ movement and +1 physical damage instead of the usual movement penalties from that level.

abilities.name: Turret
abilities.text: Turret with its own weapon values in brackets: may fire into any arc.

abilities.name: Underwater Maneuvering Unit
abilities.text: Underwater drive: moves under water using its jump movement value.

abilities.name: Watchdog
abilities.text: Combination of LPRB and ECM in one system.
